title: Optional native outcome collection
scenario: Maintainer walkthrough for source bytes matching checkpoint 1d831bf6e62e. Images browser-render actual sanitized CLI and credential-free native results, not terminal or model-performance captures. Use docs/native-trials.md for prerequisites and commands.

steps.title: Freeze and check the trial-only declaration
steps.instruction: Add the optional collection object to a trial plan; pin all 12 sources, including the collector. Declare at most 8 relative paths (4,096 encoded bytes). Run native_trial.py check with the exact private plan before an authorized attempt. Keep qualification-mode and source-drift refusals.
steps.caption: Actual CLI: valid input checked; qualification collection refused; changed collector refused. All three checks opened no authentication, launched no processes and created no attempt.
steps.expected: Only presence, byte count and SHA-256 are collected. No contents, final answers or supplied success flag are accepted. A passing check does not qualify execution.

steps.title: Separate capture, task state and cleanup
steps.instruction: Read the task receipt and collection separately. A missing file is an observation; unsafe collection blocks with no partial rows. An interrupted task stays blocked even when a file was captured. Require owned cleanup; recover never collects again.
steps.caption: Actual three-case credential-free capture: present/missing, unsafe and interrupted. The private bridge supplies observation and coordinator receipt; production observe/finish collection gates have unit coverage only. Owned cleanup and VM restoration were independently verified.
steps.expected: Snapshots are per-file and not quiescent. Trusted host access remains. These runs use no authentication or model inference and establish no answer grading, admission, natural-routing, comparison or promotion qualification.
